tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Ink-black by default; off-white paper in Light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Problem sheets, duel panels, dialogs. Edged with `hairline`, never a shadow.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Answer fields, LaTeX wells, alternating table rows.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px rules and construction lines. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: inputs, secondary buttons. 3:1+ on paper, surface, sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, and the fill of the primary button. 14:1+ on paper, surface, sunken.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink` fill (the primary button). 16:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, losses (with ✗ or −N). 5.6:1+ on paper, surface, sunken.

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: The red pencil: the only color. Elo gains, ✓ marks, the ∎, the timer under 0:30, one emphasized word. Never a fill larger than the ∎; never the primary button. Text-safe (4.9:1+) on paper, surface, sunken.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, every interactive element. 14:1+ on every surface.

families.sans: "Source Sans 3", "Source Sans Pro", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero and the result verdict. Bodoni at optical size 96.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section openers on marketing pages; page titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles and the problem header.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Find the number of ordered pairs of positive integers (a, b) with a + b = 20.
styles.usage: Problem statements and the landing lede.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Three problems, five minutes, one result.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Kickers, set in true small caps (font-variant: all-small-caps).

styles.name: theorem
styles.usage: Theorem-style statements: the label ('Theorem 1.') in 500 upright, the claim in italic, as in a journal.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Elo on profile and result screens. Bodoni lining tabular figures.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: Duel countdown; turns `pencil` under 0:30. Lining tabular figures.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Elo deltas, ranks, stats. Lining tabular figures.
